answers.core: This would change what is stored in scenes and how they're instantiated, also requiring support in the scene editor. As such, I believe it would fit best in the core of the scene system, in addition to being a generally useful OOP-style pattern.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by creating scripts for individual scenes, but like I said, doing this for multiple scenes can become slow and create noise by adding imperative logic for declarative behavior.

title: Add exported variables/properties to packed scenes to define an interface, with propagation to children
